correctness.rationale: The Pell identities c=qv-sh, v=s²-1 and c≡1 mod u are exact. For any candidate threshold T-ka, reduction modulo u forces the c coefficient z+ut, and qv<2c gives t<=1. Both coefficient blocks are explicitly enumerated: t=0 contributes p+1 at k=0 and p at 1<=k<=s; t=1 contributes one iff j=s-1 and k<=s-1. This verifies each p-Apéry threshold and residue completeness for every u>=2; the max and sum identities give g_p and n_p. A separate complete generating-function dynamic program verified all residues and hole counts for u=2,3,4,5. The finite computations do not replace the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The exact first excluded boundary p=u², complete p-Apéry set with a corrected last row, and both resulting invariants are outside Komatsu–Mu Theorems 1–2 (strict p<u²). Accessible earlier mathematical claims were compared for identical triples, formulas, and stronger coverage; none entails this boundary classification. value.rationale: Komatsu–Mu identifies the strict first excluded p=u² in the natural smallest even-even-odd Pell index family. This theorem exactly resolves that mathematical phase boundary for every u>=2, showing only one Apéry row changes and obtaining exact g_p, n_p plus nonzero corrections to extrapolation. It advances the published structural Apéry method beyond the known range in an infinite family; the boundary is intrinsically motivated, not a randomly selected numerical slice. No claim is made about all postthreshold p.
